_comment: AnimObject Swapper (AOS, D-7). Emits <file>_ANIO.ini at the mod root — swaps the prop an actor holds during an idle (a mug, a book), no ESP override. Swaps the HELD OBJECT, not the animation (that's OAR). Requires AnimObjectSwapper.dll at runtime; AOS resolves refs against the player's load order (ModForge only checks structure).

entries._comment: Anyone drinking randomly holds one of these cups.
Sofia drinks from her special mug (NPC base filter).
Female Thieves Guild members read a ledger (filter + trait).
